stem: Which additional overnight contributor is noted in some children with nocturnal enuresis?
explanation: Nocturnal polyuria is an additional overnight contributor in some children with nocturnal enuresis, alongside impaired cortical arousal and reduced bladder capacity.
rationale: The concept being tested is an additional nocturnal mechanism associated with enuresis.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because nocturnal polyuria is noted as an additional overnight contributor in some children with nocturnal enuresis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because recurrent nocturnal wheeze is not a recognised contributor to nocturnal enuresis in this context.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because constipation may be relevant to bladder symptoms, but night-time constipation only is not the listed overnight contributor here.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because hypercalcaemia is not described as a cause of nocturnal enuresis in this question.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because sleepwalking due to reflux is not a recognised mechanism for nocturnal enuresis.
